title: Record the terminal-phase port and the unverified sync stamp
action: docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/gates.md narrates the terminal state as if it always worked. Two merges. First: entering the terminal state was unreachable until it was ported - the door had been left delegating to a runtime that no longer existed - and it now carries both halves natively: the learning-capture freshness evidence with its explicit waiver, and the spec-debt threshold of R78, refused while any completed behaviour-changing unit is still missing from the specs, with two loud escapes - an explicit waiver flag, or an already-logged deferral decision naming the feature, the same escape the close door accepts. Second, as an Open Gap next to R20a: recording a knowledge sync checks the phase but never checks that any spec actually changed, so a stamp taken after completion always clears the debt door whether or not anything was written.

truths: the terminal door states both halves and both escapes
the unverified-stamp gap is recorded as an Open Gap
